title: 1.5 Children and Babies
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Name a family, a baby, babies, a child and children, and use sind for two or more people.
grammar_function: Ein/eine + noun; Sie sind + plural noun (no article); die + plural noun + plural verb.
prerequisite: German 1.1-1.4: people, articles, ist, and one-or-two-people verbs.
speaking_outcome: Say who is a baby, a child, or part of the family.

cards.pedagogy_note: Familie takes eine.
sind: ist for two or more people.
das Baby: ein Baby.
das Baby + schläft.
Plural: die Babys; every plural takes die.
No article after sind for a plural: Sie sind Babys.
das Kind: ein Kind.
ist + ein Kind.
Plural: Kinder.
die Kinder + rennen.
